claim_boundary: This artifact records dimensional and SI bookkeeping dependencies for the held scalar route. It does not close the dimensional/SI gate, derive EOM_Psi, derive T_Psi_mu_nu, validate conservation, or make physical interpretation claims.

ledger_rows.natural_unit_dimension: dimensionless action phase if divided by hbar; exact convention held
ledger_rows.SI_dimension: J s for action if restored as physical action
ledger_rows.blocker: action normalization and restored constants remain unresolved
ledger_rows.allowed_claim: S_Psi has a ledger row for future unit review.
ledger_rows.forbidden_claim: S_Psi is physically validated or dimensionally closed.

ledger_rows.SI_dimension: blocked between x0=ct and dt d3x conventions
ledger_rows.blocker: time coordinate convention and metric dimensional convention are not fixed
ledger_rows.allowed_claim: The measure is identified as a dependency.
ledger_rows.forbidden_claim: The measure closes the SI bridge.

ledger_rows.SI_dimension: J m^-3 if interpreted as energy density after coordinate choice
ledger_rows.blocker: density interpretation depends on action and measure convention
ledger_rows.allowed_claim: A candidate density dimension is tracked.
ledger_rows.forbidden_claim: The scalar density is physically established.

ledger_rows.natural_unit_dimension: X or candidate mass^1 only if canonical normalization is later adopted
ledger_rows.blocker: Psi dimension and physical identity remain unresolved
ledger_rows.allowed_claim: Psi carries an unresolved placeholder dimension X.
ledger_rows.forbidden_claim: Psi is dimensionless, canonically normalized, or physically identified.

ledger_rows.natural_unit_dimension: mass^4 if treated as four-dimensional energy density
ledger_rows.SI_dimension: J m^-3 if interpreted as energy density
ledger_rows.blocker: V(Psi) has no specified function, scale, minimum, or source role
ledger_rows.forbidden_claim: V(Psi) is physically specified or dynamically validated.

ledger_rows.natural_unit_dimension: depends on V(Psi) and Psi dimensions
ledger_rows.SI_dimension: J m^-3 X^-1 if V is energy density and Psi has dimension X
ledger_rows.blocker: dV_dPsi cannot be physically interpreted until V(Psi) and Psi units are fixed
ledger_rows.allowed_claim: dV_dPsi is a formal placeholder with dependency rows.
ledger_rows.forbidden_claim: dV_dPsi establishes a force law, mass term, or dynamics.

ledger_rows.natural_unit_dimension: depends on Psi dimension and kinetic convention
ledger_rows.SI_dimension: depends on Psi dimension, coordinate convention, and density convention
ledger_rows.blocker: Z_Psi role, sign, units, and field dependence remain unresolved
ledger_rows.allowed_claim: Z_Psi is tracked as an unresolved normalization dependency.
ledger_rows.forbidden_claim: Z_Psi is dimensionless, positive, canonical, or ghost-free.

ledger_rows.SI_dimension: blocked until space/time derivative convention is explicit
ledger_rows.blocker: space-time derivative convention is not fixed
ledger_rows.forbidden_claim: The derivative term is dimensionally closed.
